signals.usability_note: Clear view of a two-story colonial-style house frontage across a lawn; a red sedan in the foreground partially blocks the street view but not the house.
signals.notes: Well-kept two-story home with sage green siding, maroon shutters, an American flag, and trimmed foundation shrubs; two vehicles (an SUV and a green wagon) are parked in the driveway, and a red sedan in the foreground is parked on the street.
